summary: The text exceeds the limit checked by this response path.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: text is too long

possible_causes: Text supplied to the formatting helper exceeds its local byte-size guard.
diagnostic_limits: The local guard is not the public character limit for every method. Other message and caption limits can produce different descriptions.

evidence.note: The formatting helper rejects text.size() greater than 32768 before parsing.
Method validation errors are passed to the response normalizer.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: text is too long

preconditions: Check the selected method’s text or caption limits and preserve valid formatting when shortening or splitting text.
